Maybe the left blue is blocked from moving right. Let me check what's to the right of the left blue.
Row 34: YYYYSSSSSYYYYYY (cols 10-24)
- Cols 19-23: YYYYY (open)
- Col 24: Y (open)
So there's open space to the right. But the blue didn't move. Maybe the blue can only move 5 columns at a time, and there's not enough space to the right (only 5 columns of open space, cols 19-23).
Actually, the blue is 5x5. To move right 5 columns, it would need to occupy cols 19-23. But cols 19-23 are open (YYYYY). So the blue should be able to move right.
Unless... the blue is blocked by something else. Let me check the segmentation to see if there's a wall or obstacle to the right of the left blue.
